text:
Sam K: quick heads-up — I'm prepping a small 2.3.2 hotfix for the kv-cache regression hitting long prompt tails. Targeting cutoff 14:00 PT (in ~2h). Minimal diff, one-line change in runtime cache eviction. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5821 :rocket:

Julia T: thanks — can you drop the changelog blurb? I'll add release notes and push to the draft changelog.

Sam K: changelog blurb: "Fix: kv-cache eviction bug causing OOM on long contexts (2.3.2)" — short, compat note included.

Julia T: good. I'll include the migration note: none required. pinging @Kevin L for quick smoke once CI passes.

Kevin L: on it. will run smoke in staging after merge. ETA 30m.

Release Bot: scheduled release job created — release/2.3.2-hotfix will cut at 2024-03-20T21:00:00Z (14:00 PT). Auto-deploy disabled; manual promote required.

Maria P: is there any DB migration or config change? last minute ask from infra.

Sam K: no DB changes. only code: runtime/kv_cache.py around line ~128. We'll cherry-pick to release-2.3.2 branch. Diff is one small function tweak.

Kevin L: CI green except flaky test `tests/integration/test_windows_serial.py` — can we skip for this hotfix with a temporary label? :eyes: 

Julia T: ok mark with [skip-windows] and add a follow-up ticket to unflake.

Sam K: merge PR when CI green, then tag locally: `git tag -a v2.3.2-hotfix -m "kv-cache eviction fix" && git push origin v2.3.2-hotfix`.

Kevin L: smoke passed on staging (latency baseline unchanged). Ready for manual promote.

Julia T: changelog updated and entry pushed to release notes (section: patch -> bugfix).

Sam K: merging now. will post SHA when done.

Sam K: merged — SHA: abcdef1234567890. Cherry-picked to release-2.3.2 as 1234cafe.

Release Bot: deploy job queued for release/2.3.2-hotfix. Manual promote required: `./scripts/promote_release.sh release/2.3.2-hotfix`.

Maria P: infra aware, will monitor memory graphs and tail latency during cutover.

Kevin L: rolling canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% per standard guardrails. I'll run the regress prompts set and watch eval metrics.

Sam K: noted. If anything spikes, fallback to release-2.3.1 and open incident channel.

Julia T: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. :tada:
